title: Code for "Bowling alone in the AI era. Chatbot sycophancy, hyper-personalised filter bubbles, and the breakdown of deliberation"
description:
Code and data supporting the measurement of political sycophancy in GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 in “Bowling alone in the AI era. Chatbot sycophancy, hyper-personalised filter bubbles, and the breakdown of deliberation” by Minahil Malik and Mikael Sundström.

The analysis compares model agreement with and without politically aligned biographical information.
